# Cute Company Photography

> Sister-run, family-owned fine art photography studio based in Plant City, Florida, serving Tampa Bay and all of Central Florida. We photograph weddings, elopements, engagements, portraits, families, maternity, and commercial/branding sessions in a candid, natural-light, timeless style.

## About
- Location: Plant City, FL — service-area business covering Tampa, Lakeland, Brandon, Riverview, Valrico, Dover, and Central Florida
- Team: four sisters, family-owned and women-owned
- Style: candid, fine art, natural light, unscripted moments, timeless editing
- Contact: cutecompanyphotography4@gmail.com · (813) 365-9092

## Services
- [Wedding & Elopement Photography](https://cutecompanyphotography.com/services) — full-day & half-day coverage, elopements, micro-weddings, engagement sessions
- [Portrait & Family Photography](https://cutecompanyphotography.com/services) — family, maternity, newborn, senior, graduation, and editorial portraits
- [Commercial & Branding Photography](https://cutecompanyphotography.com/services) — brand sessions, product, headshots, architecture
